messages.subject: [inla] Free INLA courses?
parts:
Dear INLA-user,

we want again to offer free INLA-courses for groups of people that are
interested, for the academic year 2013-14. A course is preferably
concentrated to one day, and all our own costs related to it are
covered by us. Please email us at hr...@r-inla.org to discuss options if
you think this would be interesting for your group and others near you.
We cannot promise anything but we will do our best. Our only request is
that the participation-fee, if any at all, should only cover actual
costs for arranging the course.

There are quite a few examples of similar courses in the 'Recent
announcements' section of www.r-inla.org. We can adjust the contents of
the courses, partly, to fit local needs. For example, to
discuss more spatial modeling using SDPE's, or even do a two-day version
with more practicals.


Best
